Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner accepted an incorrect death year for Léo Joannon (1996) from a Wikipedia snippet and claimed it was corroborated despite multiple sources on the same results page (IMDb, Prabook, BornGlorious) showing 1969. This misinterpretation led to the wrong final comparison, since John Sturges died in 1992, meaning the Bad Day at Black Rock director died later.
